premises.text: Game-day fans waste time navigating parking, finding friends' tailgates, reuniting after separations, and coordinating in-stadium
premises.evidence_span: finding her friend's tailgate can be like finding a needle in a haystack

premises.text: An app provides turn-by-turn directions to parking spots from ticket/parking-pass context
premises.evidence_span: Whitney fires up the Paranoid Fan app to get turn-by-turn directions from her house to her parking spot

premises.text: Pinned tailgate map locations give the fastest route to friends' pre-game gatherings
premises.evidence_span: her friends have pinned their tailgate on the paranoid fan map, giving Whitney the fastest route to their location

premises.text: Meet Me shows friends' live locations for painless reunions
premises.evidence_span: Whitney can use the Meet Me feature to see exactly where her friends are

premises.text: Live geofence chat lets nearby fans share photos, video, and info in reverse chronological order
premises.evidence_span: they're entered into a live geofence chat stream that allows fans within two miles of the 50-yard line to share photos, video, information

premises.text: Stadium mapping and Ticketmaster API integration extend deployment across venues and ticket purchase
premises.evidence_span: an official API integration with Ticketmaster
